title: SQL Injection Prevention
summary: SQL injection exploits dynamic string building. Parameterized queries and least-privilege DB users reduce risk.
objectives: Explain SQL Injection Prevention in practical web-development terms
Recognize how SQL connects to HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
Apply safe habits and avoid common mistakes

content.md: Example attack input: `' OR '1'='1` in a concatenated login query — prepared statements neutralize this class of attack.

quickRecap: Practice with the quiz — execution on device is limited to HTML/CSS/JS in the playground.

exercise.prompt: Review the example, then open the playground only when the lesson uses HTML/CSS/JS starter code. Complete the quiz to earn XP.
